general_information.Syllabus Name: Principles of Compositing_Thiết kế hình ảnh và âm thanh
general_information.Description: This course will teach students how to make motion graphics and how to create visual effects using Adobe After Effects software, with the encouraged application of AI technology to support idea development during the pre-production stage. At the end of the course, students will know how to apply the knowledge of timing, rhythm, and composition to create a complete animation product.
general_information.StudentTasks: - Attend at least 80% of contact hours in order to be accepted to the final examination - Actively participate in class activities - Fulfil tasks given by intructor after class - Use their own laptop in class only for learning purpose - Read the textbook in advance - Access the course website (https://flm.fpt.edu.vn/) for up-to-date information and material of the course. - Computer with some version of photograph editing software such as Photoshop, Microsoft Word for written assignments, and POWERPOINT for presentations - Have color papers, Color Pencils, scissors... - Using AI tools such as Gemini and ChatGPT to develop ideas and support the pre-production stage.
general_information.Tools: Adobe After Effects CC, Adobe Photoshop CC, Adobe Illustrator, Gemini, ChatGPT,…

description: This course will teach students how to make motion graphics and how to create visual effects using Adobe After Effects software, with the encouraged application of AI technology to support idea development during the pre-production stage. At the end of the course, students will know how to apply the knowledge of timing, rhythm, and composition to create a complete animation product.

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Students are able to combine principles of graphic design and motion, and able to create animated graphics which highlight harmony and unity between images and sounds
Understanding the fundamentals of digital animation
Basic design principals as it applies to Motion Graphics
Use After Effects efficiently and effectively
Creatively integrate text, image, video and sound using motion graphics techniques
Create professional animation sequences and composites using a variety of features, with the integration of AI tools to support the ideation and pre-production stages.
Having a professional working style. Practice and develop ethics, professionalism.

assessments.CLO: CLO1, CLO2, CLO3, CLO5, CLO6, CLO7
assessments.Knowledge and Skill: Apply the principles of digital animation and motion graphics to carry out the pre-production stage, with the goal of creating a product that demonstrates harmony between visuals and sound. Develop ideas and develop a concept for the product by completing all essential steps of pre-production, including: idea summary, moodboard, script or shot list, storyboard, character/background/font design (if applicable), and animatic. The use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools during the pre-production stage is encouraged to support idea development. Submission requirements: A presentation slide summarizing all pre-production steps Notes on how AI was applied (if applicable) An animatic video (MP4, H.264)
assessments.Note: Idea: 1 point Content: 2 point Visuals: 2 point Technique: 2 point Creativity & Personal Signature: 2 point Awareness & Professional Attitude: 1 point

assessments.Knowledge and Skill: Apply knowledge of graphic design, motion design, and After Effects skills to execute the production stage of a project developed during the pre-production phase. Content: Develop content that aligns with the theme and integrates graphics and motion harmoniously. Visuals: Design characters, layouts, backgrounds, typography, etc., with clear concepts, aesthetic quality, creativity, and consistent presentation. Technical skills: Demonstrate strong skills in illustration, animation, compositing, rhythm perception, and proficient use of After Effects in production. Creativity & Personal Signature: The product should show high creativity and reflect a clear personal style. Professional Attitude & Ethics: Work seriously and professionally, with strong awareness of copyright. No plagiarism or imitation is allowed. Submission requirements: Students must submit a 50% completed version of the project and supporting evidence files. Video: MP4 (H.264). Working file: After Effects project file (.aep).
assessments.Note: Content: 1 point Visuals: 3 point Technique: 3 point Creativity & Personal Signature: 2 point Awareness & Professional Attitude: 1 point

assessments.Knowledge and Skill: Apply knowledge of graphic design, motion design, and After Effects skills to carry out the production, post-production, and finalization stages of the product. Content: Develop content that aligns with the theme and integrates graphics and motion harmoniously. Visuals: Design characters, layouts, backgrounds, typography, etc., with clear concepts, aesthetic quality, creativity, and consistent presentation. Technical skills: Demonstrate strong skills in illustration, animation, compositing, rhythm perception, and proficient use of After Effects throughout production and post-production. Creativity & Personal Signature: The final product should reflect high creativity and a strong personal style. Professional Attitude & Ethics: Work professionally and responsibly, with full awareness of copyright regulations. Plagiarism or imitation is strictly prohibited. Students must submit the final completed product along with supporting files: Slide presentation. Final video: MP4 (H264). Working file After Effects (.aep)
assessments.Note: Content: 1 point Visuals: 3 point Technique: 3 point Creativity & Personal Signature: 2 point Awareness & Professional Attitude: 1 point

assessments.Grading Guide: Participation grade will be given based on students' attendance, preparation, and quantity as well as quality of participation in classroom; quality of participation is demonstrated through asking relevant questions, making statements that add to and facilitate class discussion, and builds upon others’ comments.
